name: Recursive hit zoom

dependencies.reason: event model, chop snapshot, flatten(), RNG, byte codec

threading: Pure functions; thread-safe. Not real-time safe.
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/recursive_hit_zoom -B build/recursive_hit_zoom && cmake --build build/recursive_hit_zoom && ctest --test-dir build/recursive_hit_zoom
summary: Creates a nested child pattern inside one event's exact time window and source bounds. Children never read outside their ancestor's source range unless an explicit source replacement is requested.
public_api: `mutateChildren(parentWithChild, context, settings, seed)` keeps locked child events
limits: Subdivisions 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 8; minimum 15 ticks per child
Depth 2 by default, 3 hard maximum; exceeding the event budget returns `LimitExceeded` with the nearest permitted subdivision, never a truncation
adapters: Your UI chooses the parent event and shows the breadcrumb; the composition root supplies `Context` (source bounds, depth, event budget).
adapter_notes: If your project has no nested pattern model, store the returned child tree as module-owned state and call this module's `flatten()` before playback.
removal: Delete the folder; events simply lose the optional child tree.
